If not, I want to hear your feedback, things that we can do better.'

notable.note: Cleanest process call in the batch and the only completed onboarding — all four P11 steps executed and confirmed on the call. Two things a principal should see anyway: a one-month 'love it or leave it' trial was invented live and is not part of the published offer, and the first-month price is never stated in the transcript despite payment being taken. Separately, the prospect disclosed scoliosis and lumbar hyperlordosis, explicitly said he feared entrenching bad posture, and the rep responded by promising a mobility routine 'aligned with the scoliosis' without anyone asking whether a clinician had cleared him for loaded work.
